Torterra

Grass Ground

Sinnoh · Generation 4

Torterra is a Grass/Ground-type Continent Pokémon first found in Sinnoh (Generation 4). It stands 2.2 m tall and weighs 310 kg. It evolves from Grotle. Its highest base stat is Attack (109), with a base stat total of 525.
